name: 45434 · Beavercreek, OH
findings: ZIP 45434 (Beavercreek) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45434 (Beavercreek) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45434 (Beavercreek) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
